# Proposal vs Jimmy's lines (same band or a different structure)

His lines are rough in height as well as thickness, so this is not an accuracy score: it counts the proposed columns whose midline lies within 150 µm of his midline (same band) and beyond it (a different structure, or his line is off), and says where the beyond ones sit. Before = the old rule (columns not flagged); after = the columns that carry curve points now. Nothing was tuned to these lines except as the PR body says.
